title: Established CrisisMMD task with a published baseline
baseline_reference: Ofli, Alam and Imran, ISCRAM 2020 (multimodal), with single-modality baselines from the same paper
official_split: CrisisMMD v2.0 train/dev/test as released by the dataset authors
steps: 1. Reproduce the published single-modality and multimodal baseline numbers on the official split. Record the reproduction gap per task and modality.
2. Using the class handling chosen by item A, run the budgeting comparison (all methods of itemC_protocol.json) on each task under the three carried-over conditions.
3. Report both tasks; do not pick the one that favours the optimizer.
notes: No runner script is supplied for item B because the official task labels and split files are not part of the shipped derived features; the adapter must load them from the corpus obtained from its authors. Freeze this protocol (its .sha256 sidecar) before any run.
